constraint:authorities:authorities_check: CHECK (phase = 'fenced'::text OR epoch IS NOT NULL AND primary_id IS NOT NULL AND token_store_id IS NOT NULL AND source_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND history_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND acceptance_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
constraint:creations:creations_check1: CHECK (requested_subject IS NULL OR requested_subject = (subject COLLATE "C"))
constraint:history_entries:history_entri: CHECK (epoch IS NULL AND worker_id IS NULL AND slot IS NULL AND generation IS NULL OR epoch IS NOT NULL AND worker_id IS NOT NULL AND slot IS NOT NULL AND slot >= 0 AND slot <= 63 AND generation IS NOT NULL AND generation > 0)
CHECK (kind = 0 AND subject IS NULL OR kind = 1 AND subject IS NOT NULL AND organization_witness.history_subject(subject))
constraint:slots:slots_check: CHECK (NOT pending OR generation > 0 AND epoch IS NOT NULL AND worker_id IS NOT NULL AND principal IS NOT NULL)

function:creation_digest(value text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.creation_digest(value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT octet_length(value)=64 AND value ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
$function$

function:creation_event(p_environment uu.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.creation_event(p_environment uuid, p_operation uuid, p_reserving boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
DECLARE c organization_witness.creations%ROWTYPE; n integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM organization_witness.creations WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND operation_id=p_operation;
 UPDATE organization_witness.creation_counts SET events=events+1,reserved=reserved+CASE WHEN p_reserving THEN 1 ELSE -1 END
  WHERE environment_id=p_environment RETURNING events INTO STRICT n;
 INSERT INTO organization_witness.creation_events(environment_id,sequence,operation_id,attempt,state,epoch,slot,generation,worker_id,principal,receipt_sha256)
 VALUES(c.environment_id,n,c.operation_id,c.attempt,c.state,c.epoch,c.slot,c.generation,c.worker_id,c.principal,c.receipt_sha256);
END $function$

function:history_check(p_environment uui.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.history_check(p_environment uuid, p_deployment uuid, p_slot integer, p_generation bigint, p_epoch uuid, p_worker uuid, p_owner uuid, p_subject text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM organization_witness.history_require_admission(p_environment,p_deployment,p_slot,p_generation,p_epoch,p_worker);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM organization_witness.history_entries WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND kind=1 AND owner_id=p_owner AND subject=p_subject COLLATE "C")
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'permanent subject missing'; END IF;
 RETURN organization_witness.history_progress(p_environment);
END $function$

function:history_progress(p_environment.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.history_progress(p_environment uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('environment_id',environment_id,'issuer_host',issuer_host,
  'operation_id',operation_id,'control_revision',control_revision,'receipt_id',receipt_id,
  'manifest_sha256',manifest_sha256,'inventory_sha256',inventory_sha256,
  'expected_owners',expected_owners,'expected_subjects',expected_subjects,'expected_digest',expected_digest,
  'sequence',sequence,'owner_count',owner_count,'subject_count',subject_count,
  'digest',encode(digest,'hex'),'sealed',sealed)
 FROM organization_witness.history_namespaces WHERE environment_id=p_environment
$function$

function:history_require_admission(p_env.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.history_require_admission(p_environment uuid, p_deployment uuid, p_slot integer, p_generation bigint, p_epoch uuid, p_worker uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
DECLARE a organization_witness.authorities%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM organization_witness.authorities WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND deployment_id=p_deployment FOR UPDATE;
 IF a.phase<>'active' OR a.epoch IS DISTINCT FROM p_epoch OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM organization_witness.slots WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND slot=p_slot AND generation=p_generation
   AND epoch=p_epoch AND worker_id=p_worker AND principal=session_user AND pending)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM organization_witness.history_namespaces WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND sealed)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'history admission refused'; END IF;
END $function$

function:history_require_fence(p_environ.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.history_require_fence(p_environment uuid, p_deployment uuid, p_operation uuid, p_revision bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
DECLARE a organization_witness.authorities%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM organization_witness.authorities
  WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND deployment_id=p_deployment FOR UPDATE;
 IF a.phase<>'fenced' OR a.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_operation OR a.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_revision
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM organization_witness.slots WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND pending)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'history requires exact drained fence'; END IF;
END $function$

function:history_subject(value text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.history_subject(value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8')) BETWEEN 1 AND 255
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM generate_series(0,octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))-1) AS bytes(i)
                WHERE get_byte(convert_to(value,'UTF8'),bytes.i)>127)
$function$

function:pending_work(p_environment uuid.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION organization_witness.pending_work(p_environment uuid, p_deployment uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'organization_witness'
AS $function$
DECLARE a organization_witness.authorities%ROWTYPE; admissions jsonb;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM organization_witness.authorities
        WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND deployment_id=p_deployment FOR SHARE;
    -- All admission/transition writers lock this same authority row exclusively.
    -- This observation therefore contains one state and its exact pending set.
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.slot),'[]'::jsonb)
        INTO admissions FROM organization_witness.slots s
        WHERE s.environment_id=p_environment AND s.pending;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('state',to_jsonb(a) || jsonb_build_object('pending',jsonb_array_length(admissions)),
                              'admissions',admissions);
END $function$
